scores.evidence: Week 1: Data pipeline setup, document ingestion; Week 2: Vector DB setup; Week 3: LLM integration
scores.rationale: Ingestion → index → LLM is loosely substrate-upward, but nothing is proven before dependents and security/evals come late or unordered.
No thin end-to-end production slice first; deployment is last after component-by-component build.
Options are listed with no defaults or flip conditions; irreversible choices are left open.
No within-phase ordering by blast radius.
No security, PII, access control, or prompt-injection treatment anywhere.
Monitoring appears only at the end plus a tool mention, not from phase zero.
No pinned versions, reproducible builds, or data/index versioning; only a passing mention of doc version control.
No failure handling (timeouts, fallbacks, LLM outages) across phases; only escalation to humans as a feature.

scores.evidence: Constraints: "Only use provided context", "If unsure, escalate"
scores.rationale: Has retrieval, generation, escalation, and feedback, but no budgets or defenses first, and order is features-first with human escalation only as a feature.
No explicit deferred list or pull-forward conditions; features are all listed as included.

note: Generic RAG overview with a weekly timeline; lacks walking skeleton, decision gates, threaded security/resilience/reproducibility, and deferral conditions.
